# address: # Names applied to the 1.2.0 Ghidra program by ApplyNames.java. "_q" suffix = best guess.

name: Reset_Handler
note: MCUXpresso startup: FlexRAM config, data/bss tables, stack fill, libc init, main

name: fw_request_update
note: writes ptf name to /Firmware/_fwinfo, "start" to /Firmware/_turnon, resets

name: song_grid_draw
note: song screen: 16 x 12 grid of track blocks; filled color = theme+0x04 or +0x1c, empty = +0x20

name: song_grid_track_selection
note: tracks bounding box of the selected cells

name: song_ctrl_draw_grid
note: vtable 0x60046c80 slot; calls song_grid_draw then song_grid_overlay_q

name: scr_song_set_grid_data
note: fills screen+0xcc grid data (slots, masks, track flags) and calls disp_ctrl_set_data

name: pattern_update_track_usage
note: (ctx, patternNo 1-based, patternData): sets project lo/hi track-used bits; returns changed

name: crt_frame_dummy_q
note: GCC crtstuff; carries the image-end symbol 0x601bab78

name: BOARD_ConfigMPU
note: MPU regions; 0x20280000 falls in region 4 (RW, Device)

name: scr_song_start
note: Song screen entry: usage_current, then bl scr_song_set_grid_data at 0x600fe402

name: pattern_read_file
note: open(path, mode 0) / read 0x3030 / close via FS vtable

name: fs_open
note: +0x2c: (res{handle,ok}, fs, path, mode, x); allocates a 0x104 handle

name: fs_read
note: +0x30: (fs, buf, size, handle) -> bytes read or -1 (FatFs f_read)

name: fatfs_f_read
note: direct disk_read into caller buffer for >=512 at sector boundary, else via FIL+0x50

name: sd_read_blocks
note: NXP SD_ReadBlocks: card lock (infinite wait), bounce buffer for unaligned

# address: # Sequencer and FX timing (FINDINGS section 12). seq = 0x20017274; ITCM addresses are execution addresses.

name: dma0_dma16_irq
note: IRQ 0: eDMA handler for the audio-out DMA channel

name: audio_dma_cb
note: eDMA callback: picks the ping-pong half, calls *(0x2000a804) = audio_out_cb

name: audio_out_cb
note: platform audio callback: app object vtable +8 with 128 frames

name: app_audio_block
note: app 0x200170e0 vtable +8: midi_poll_input, seq_advance (bl at 0x600aa7f8), engine_block_update

name: seq_advance
note: (seq, seconds): float us accumulator at 0x20017270; ext clock = 96 ticks per pulse

name: seq_tick
note: count-in, ++seq+0x10, every 12th tick: master micro + process/advance tracks 0..15

name: seq_master_micro
note: seq+0x2e 1..48, seq+0x30 master step, step-changed callback seq+0x6f0

name: seq_process_track
note: (seq, t) every micro-step: step copy (0x2170), FX switch (tbh 0x2686), delays, roll, arp, preload request

name: seq_record_live_note
note: live recording: writes m (FX1) and V (FX2) by recording options

name: seq_trigger_note
note: (seq, t, rec): sample voice note-on with FX, MIDI/synth note-on

name: seq_play_from
note: (seq, step): note-offs, reset positions, playing = 1, MIDI start

name: seq_reset_positions
note: track steps to 0 (or last for backward mode)

name: seq_ext_clock_tempo_q
note: external clock interval averaging, seq+0x7d4 BPM

name: midi_send_cc
note: (cc, value, channel, synth): ports by settings+0x2c, nothing while rendering

name: fx_display_value
note: (seq, type, value): shown value (panning, micro-tune, tune, slice, tempo)

name: seq_distance_to_next_note_q
note: (seq, t, step): roll look-ahead in the play buffer

name: engine_block_update
note: after seq_advance: tempo average, voice_block_update for the 8 players

name: voice_block_update_q
note: per-block voice update (envelopes, LFO FX, automation)

name: voice_apply_fx
note: (player, type, value, column): per-FX setters, masks IRQ 0

name: voice_note_on_q
note: (player, instrument, note, volume, fx1 type, fx1 value, fx2 type, fx2 value)

name: voice_set_cutoff
note: (norm float, player): table lookup, coefficient into each filter object +0x1c

name: seq_advance_step
note: (seq, t) after micro 48: next step, wrap, pattern end on t = 15

name: song_advance_position
note: project+0x6c1 += 1, wraps at an empty playlist slot (returns 0)

name: fm_request_pattern_load
note: (fm 0x2001e488, pattern): sets file-manager state 0xe; the main loop loads it

name: fm_state_pattern_preload_q
note: sub-states: save current pattern if edited, load, done

name: serial_tx_byte
note: 512-byte TX ring + non-blocking LPUART transfer; no full-ring check

name: seq_change_selection_fx_value
note: (selection, column, delta): encoder edit; min hard-coded, max fx_max

name: fx_value_text
note: (seq, buf, size, type, value, compact): "%3i" / "%i" by default

name: patfill_change_value_q
note: Fill popup value change (uses fx_min / fx_max)

name: voice_update_cutoff_q
note: applies player+0x30 through voice_set_cutoff (or the automation path)

name: pat_show_page

name: pat_bind_page1

name: pat_bind_page2
note: Render Selection, Invert, Duplicate, Expand, Shrink, Copy, Paste, More

name: pat_bind_page3
note: Pattern Name, Track Name, buttons 2..6 unused, More

name: pat_labels_page3
note: sets colors and data only for buttons 0, 1 and 7

name: pat_more_button
note: next page when no other button is held

name: pat_invert_button
note: undo_push, ed_selection_to_seq, seq_invert_selection, fill rows, mark changed

name: ed_selection_to_seq

name: seq_set_selection

name: ed_selected_column_q

name: pat_record_button

name: pat_edit_mode_changed

name: cfg_menu_build

name: cfg_menu_folder

name: cfg_menu_item

name: cfg_menu_open_editor

name: cfg_menu_draw_folder

name: cfg_menu_back

name: cfg_menu_select

name: cfg_menu_encoder

name: cfg_number_editor

name: cfg_menu_apply

name: audio_memory_init

name: game_start_q

name: nes_load_q

name: nes6502_execute_q

name: game_fb_init_q
note: game screen buffer at SDRAM 0x83fd99e0 (256 x 240)
